Domestic CASA ratio 38.90% as of Mar-2026, down 107 bps YoY.
Credit cost 0.46% for FY26; Q4FY26 credit cost 0.76%.
Provision coverage ratio including TWO 93.94% as of Mar-2026.
Board approved raising up to ₹6,000 Cr via AT1 and/or Tier II bonds in suitable tranches up to 31.03.2027 and beyond, subject to statutory/regulatory approvals.
FCNR(B) mobilisation was about USD 700 mn as of the call, with a target of USD 4-5 bn across FCNR(B), MTN/OFCB and ECB routes by the 31 December 2026 swap window.
Domestic credit-deposit ratio was 83.31% and CASA ratio 37.72% at 30 June 2026; bulk plus CD deposits were about ₹2.31 lakh Cr.
IT budget for the year is in excess of ₹4,000 Cr (opex plus capex); the bank plans to hire about 7,000 people in FY27.

timeline.summary: Bank of Baroda scheduled Media Meet (Zoom) and Analyst Meet (virtual) on 8 May 2026 at 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM, respectively, for Q&A on FY26 results.

Bank of Baroda received a PFRDA Letter of Appointment to act as Sponsor of Pension Fund under the 2026 guidelines and proposes to set up a Pension Fund Management Company, subject to other regulatory approvals.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹34,513.73 Cr, net profit ₹5,647.96 Cr (+4.2% YoY).
Bank of Baroda's Q4FY26/FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 net profit of ₹20,021 Cr (up 2.2%) and Q4FY26 net profit of ₹5,616 Cr; with GNPA at 1.89%.
2026-05-08: Bank of Baroda's board approved raising up to ₹6,000 Cr via Additional Tier 1 and/or Tier II bonds in tranches up to 31.03.2027, subject to statutory/regulatory approvals.
Bank of Baroda shared Q4 FY2025-26 financial results media and analyst meet recordings via its website on 08.05.2026.
Bank of Baroda reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹5,616 Cr, up 11.2% YoY, and upsized FY27 loan growth guidance to 12-14%.
Bank of Baroda corrected its Annual Report for FY2025-26, fixing the Dividend Payout Ratio (21.96% vs. 22.05%) and a typographical error in provisions (₹(21.05) vs. ₹21.05) on 31-Mar-2026.
